text: An analyst asks a hosted assistant to explain a pandas error message, pasting the traceback only.
An analyst pastes the pilot roster with pilots' names and shifts into a hosted assistant to find fatigue risks.
The assistant drafts the summary of a board paper; the analyst edits the wording and sends it without a disclosure line.
The assistant writes the code of a dwell-time analysis; the analyst runs it, checks three numbers by hand and keeps the run.
The assistant gives a waiting-time reduction of 18%; the analyst copies it into the draft and plans to check it after the review.
An analyst uses the authority's approved assistant on the public cargo statistics and keeps prompts and outputs in the repository.
A new analyst has used the assistant for every analysis for six months and never worked a problem unaided.
An analyst tries a new free chatbot found online on anonymised berth data.
